valueStatus: All values except demoData follow Submission #1 v8 (Section 6.2, Operating parameters), where the group approved them, including charging.scheduler and charging.targetBatteryPercent. demoData is mock data for the classroom demonstration. Every value below is read by the server (server/src/config.js); an invalid value stops the server at start with a message.

scheduler.note: Approved values (Submission #1 v8: BR-21, BR-22, BR-43 and Section 6.2). The estimated session length only feeds the queue-time estimate, which is not a guarantee (BR-43). A shared vehicle is displaced only when the waiting request is clearly ahead (class H against class L, or a score higher by preemptMarginPoints); a booked vehicle or one at preemptMaxBatteryPercent or more is never displaced. No maximum session duration is applied. The Hub Power Limit is a capacity limit, not a weight.

demoData.note: Seed values for the classroom demonstration; they are not approved operating parameters. All three Hubs have the same 5 kW limit for five 1 kW chargers, so all chargers run together in normal operation; the limit only binds in a what-if run (for example a power outage with a smaller backup supply).
